definitions: The actual application or use of an idea, belief, or method, as opposed to theories relating to it.
The customary way of doing something; a habit or custom.
Repeated exercise in or performance of an activity or skill so as to acquire or maintain proficiency in it.
The business or profession of a doctor, lawyer, or other professional.
A session of repeated exercise or performance to acquire or maintain proficiency.
examples: It is good in theory, but not in practice.
It was his usual practice to read before bed.
She needs more practice at the piano.
He joined a large medical practice.
The team had a long practice this morning.
